notes: Hiphil (infinitive construct used substantively, "the one who is stronger", Eccl.6.10) is attested but wasn't part of the original request -- added per the full-stem-coverage check. It's attested only via a ketiv/qere textual variant: the ketiv reads שהתקיף (this root, a verb), while the qere reads a completely different word, שֶׁתַּקִּיף (H8623, an adjective "strong") -- kept since the ketiv is lemma-tagged to this root specifically and represents a genuinely distinct reading, not a spelling variant of the qere. As with H7693 above, this form was only extractable after this session's ketiv-handling pipeline fix.
Gloss collision: "prevail" is shared verbatim by the existing עזז (H5810) and גבר (H1396), both "be strong; prevail" -- distinct roots, disambiguating search alias added.

Trimmed hiphil's "be stronger; prevail" to "be stronger" per the tightened compound-gloss standard: the ketiv citation itself ("the one who is stronger") shows only the comparative-strength sense; "prevail" was an inferential extension, not what the citation names.
